summary: Approved sequence sheets for IS-3 tablets (WA/2018/082) for Istravune Biosciences: twenty-four-month ICH stability pulls, method validation summary and the shelf-life review. The long-term trend supported Istravune's proposed shelf life, and the method remained suitable through the final pull. Project and LIMS numbers remain local.

sheets.name: Summary

rows.v: Westravelle Analytical Ltd, a Tarnovell company
Istravune IS-3 tablets: twenty-four-month ICH programme

rows: Twenty-four-month ICH stability of IS-3 tablets, with assay and related-substances qualification. Pulls to 24 months; interim review completed 30 Apr 2019.

Assay at time zero was {{PRJ0091:stability.t0_assay}} % label claim. The long-term trend supports the proposed shelf life. The method remained suitable through the final pull. Conclusions are limited to the tested interval.

sheets.name: Pulls
rows: Assay as % label claim (HPLC). Impurities as % area. Water by Karl Fischer. Pulls from the ICH chamber programme as recorded on the batch card. Time zero is one initial analysis shared by all storage conditions; repeated initial rows do not represent separate pulls.

sheets.name: Method

rows.v: Method validation summary: assay and related substances

rows: Assay and related-substances validation parameters and their acceptance criteria are summarised below.

sheets.name: Review
rows: Long-term data at 25 °C/60% RH support the proposed shelf life within the tested interval. Intermediate data also extend to the final reported timepoint; accelerated results stop at six months and show greater impurity growth. All reported pulls comply.

The method validation parameters meet their stated acceptance criteria. The project review concluded that the method remained suitable through the final pull; sequence-specific checks remain in the approved sequence sheets.
